subject: Atelier Analytics - rollout cadence and MAP alignment
messages:
From: Asha Patil <asha@atelier-analytics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: MAP review & phased rollout cadence

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday — we left excited about the performance profile and the dedicated capacity options. Per our discussion, attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (Atelier-MAP-v1.xlsx) showing a proposed phased rollout for the next 14 weeks. High-level asks:

- Confirm owners for each milestone (we've filled suggested names).
- Confirm network/firewall requirements by Oct 10 so our infra team can schedule port open windows.
- Sign the SOW via DocuSign once we align on dates (I’ll send after your confirmation).

Top risks we flagged: data residency validation for EU subsets and a short QA window for our analytics pipelines.

Can we lock a 30-min alignment tomorrow at 11am PT? If that doesn’t work, propose 2 alternatives.

Attachments: Atelier-MAP-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)

Best,
Asha Patil
Head of Platform Partnerships | Atelier Analytics
asha@atelier-analytics.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patil <asha@atelier-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Oct 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP review & phased rollout cadence

Hi Asha — thanks for this and for the clear MAP. I reviewed the workbook and left a few inline comments. Quick responses:

- 30-min alignment tomorrow at 11am PT works for me.
- We’ll propose a slightly tightened QA window for week 9 to ensure we don’t miss metric regression checks.
- I’m attaching a Redwood MAP template (RI_MAP_Template.xlsx) with our preferred milestones and a suggested rollback/fallback policy.

Proposed owners (can Marissa confirm):
- Integration & onboarding lead: Marissa Cole (CS)
- Runtime config & model pinning: Karthik Iyer (Platform Eng)
- Network onboarding: Vivek (I’ll coordinate with infra)

Asha — please confirm the DocuSign contact and whether procurement needs a separate PO before signature.

Attachments: RI_MAP_Template.xlsx (spreadsheet, 85KB)

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patil <asha@atelier-analytics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Oct 2028 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP review & phased rollout cadence

Asha, Vivek — thanks. I’ve reviewed both attachments and put a compact launch plan below so we can present a single unified timeline on tomorrow’s call:

1) Week 0-1: Contract + PO + DocuSign (Atelier sign-off) — Owner: Asha / Atelier
2) Week 2-3: Network & Provisioning — Owner: Vivek / Redwood Infra; Deliverable: network checklist + test endpoints
3) Week 4-6: Integration & Data Validation (staging) — Owner: Marissa; Deliverable: validated sample pipelines + latency sanity tests
4) Week 7-8: Pre-prod load tests & canary config — Owner: Karthik; Deliverable: canary runbook + metric thresholds
5) Week 9: QA regression window & final acceptance — Owner: Marissa + Atelier QA
6) Week 10: Go-live (phased) — Owner: Cross-functional; Deliverable: go-live playbook, rollback steps

Open items for alignment on the call:
- Exact blackout windows for Atelier’s analytics peak days (please share the calendar range).
- EU data subset handling for query routing — does Atelier want regional pinning or token-level masking?
- Confirmation on on-call rotation for week 10 (we recommend 24/7 for the first 72 hours).

I’ll bring a brief resource roster to the meeting. Vivek, Karthik — I listed you folks as technical approvers; please flag if you want different owners.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

On Tue, Oct 2, 2028 at 11:05 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Asha — thanks for this and for the clear MAP....

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Asha Patil <asha@atelier-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Oct 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP review & phased rollout cadence

Adding a few technical sequencing notes ahead of our call:

- Network: Atelier needs to provide their egress IP list by Oct 10. We can open ports in one maintenance window (2 hours) during week 2. Any exceptions?
- Models: Recommend pinning to the verified model build we demonstrated; we’ll snapshot the model and publish a canary variant for week 7 testing.
- Caching & KV: For analytics workloads, enable prefix caching for top-10 queries — I’ll share a suggested cache policy doc on the drive.

Known risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Short QA window could miss upstream ETL regressions. Mitigation: add an automated smoke test suite and extend week 9 by 2 days if initial runs show failures.
- Risk: EU routing complexity. Mitigation: we can do region pinning per-tenant; this adds ~1 week to infra setup if required.

Attachments: network_diagram.pdf (PDF, 200KB)

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/5843

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Platform Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP review & phased rollout cadence

Vivek / Marissa / Karthik — all sounds good, thanks for the clarity. Confirming the following after internal sync:

- PO will be submitted by Oct 6; DocuSign signature expected by Oct 8.
- We’ll provide egress IP list and peak-day blackout calendar by Oct 10.
- Atelier accepts the proposed owners and the week 9 QA + 2 day extension if needed.

Next steps:
1) Vivek — please send a calendar invite for the 30-min alignment tomorrow at 11am PT.
2) Marissa — please attach the resource roster and an initial on-call schedule to the shared Drive folder before the call.
3) Karthik — any pre-reads you want the Atelier infra team to review, please drop in the Drive link.

We’ll aim to have the SOW signed and tech kickoff scheduled the week of Oct 9. Looking forward to working with you.

Best,
Asha Patil
Head of Platform Partnerships | Atelier Analytics
asha@atelier-analytics.com
